notes: Added missing schema, data loading, core enhancement, and integration validation stories for FEAT-2.

stories.title: Define Specialty Identification Schema and Contracts
stories.description: Create Pydantic models for specialty identification input (user query, context) and output (NUCC codes, confidence scores, labels) to standardize contracts across services and tool router.

stories.title: Load and Normalize NUCC Specialty Taxonomy Data
stories.description: Implement ingestion and normalization of NUCC taxonomy codes into a structured format usable by specialty_service, ensuring deduplicated mappings and consistent labeling.

stories.title: Implement Confidence Scoring and Ranking Logic
stories.description: Enhance specialty_service to assign confidence scores to matched specialties, rank results, and enforce thresholds for downstream provider search usage.

stories.title: Validate Integration with Provider Search Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Ensure specialty identification outputs correctly drive taxonomy fallback in provider_search_service, validating end-to-end flow from query to filtered provider results.
